summary: The requirement document describes a platform for a trucking company with 140 trucks to plan delivery trips, track trucks live and run an Android driver app. Drivers scan parcels and capture proof of delivery, customers get SMS tracking links, and accounts staff produce GST freight invoices that go to Tally. Fleet managers see fuel, service and delivery reports.

evidence.quote: Dispatchers and customers shall see trucks live on a map, with the expected arrival time at each stop.

stories: As a dispatcher, I can see trucks live on a map with the expected arrival time at each stop
As a customer, I can see my truck live on a map with the expected arrival time

evidence.quote: Drivers shall use an Android app to see their trips, start and finish each stop, and call the customer.

stories: As a driver, I can see my trips in the Android app
As a driver, I can start and finish each stop and call the customer

evidence.quote: Drivers shall scan the barcode on every parcel at pickup and delivery with the phone camera.

stories: As a driver, I can scan the barcode on every parcel at pickup and delivery
As a driver, I can capture the receiver's signature and a photo as proof of delivery

evidence.quote: The driver app shall keep working on highways without mobile network and send the data when the network returns.

stories: As a driver, I can keep using the app without network and have my data sent when the network returns

evidence.quote: Customers shall receive an SMS with a tracking link when their parcel is out for delivery.

stories: As a customer, I get an SMS with a tracking link when my parcel is out for delivery

evidence.quote: Trip expenses above ₹5,000 shall go to the fleet manager for approval.

stories: As a fleet manager, I can approve trip expenses above ₹5,000

evidence.quote: Accounts staff shall generate GST freight invoices for customers each month.

stories: As an accounts user, I can generate GST freight invoices for customers each month

evidence.quote: Invoices and payments shall be sent to Tally automatically every day.

stories: As an accounts user, I have invoices and payments sent to Tally automatically every day

evidence.quote: Fleet managers shall see reports of trips, delays, fuel cost per kilometre and on-time delivery.

stories: As a fleet manager, I can see reports of trips, delays, fuel cost per kilometre and on-time delivery

other_features.name: GPS tracker data feed
